_doc: GROUND TRUTH for agent work in this repo. Machine-first: written to be read and updated by AI agents. Human-readable detail lives in docs/, ISSUES.md and artifacts/ and is only referenced here (refs/issue), never duplicated. Rules for using this file: AGENTS.md §TODO workflow.

status_legend.done: finished AND verified — kept forever for traceability, never deleted or renumbered

resume.state: 24.09: T12 DONE — saveKindlePNG + writePNGChunk implemented in src/kindle-dash/convert.go (manual PNG: SIG + IHDR bd=8 ct=0 interlace=0 + ONE compress/zlib IDAT over all filter-0 rows + CRC32 IEEE; NOT image/png). Self-test in convert_test.go PASS (1 IDAT / bd8 / ct0 / dims + pixel-exact *image.Gray round-trip). docs/03 shell validator passes on a 1072×1448 sample; Python reference golden: Go raw scanlines byte-identical to save_kindle_png. linux/arm GOARM=7 build still 6,291,616 B (= reference; saveKindlePNG is dead code until T13 wires it in). On card (unchanged): refresh.sh v4 + dash (mmap, INVISIBLE) running; visible = bistable dashboard.png. T19/T18 still blocked on the user's n8n API key (independent of T13-T17).
resume.how_to_resume: Work exactly one todo at a time, respecting depends_on. Next = T13 (main.go get(): drop all rotation/mirror handling of the INPUT — the image arrives pre-oriented from n8n; keep fetch, decode, grayscale/downscale, quantize; DASH_FLIPX/Y become obsolete; wire the output through saveKindlePNG so the arm build now includes it and size grows past 6.29 MB). Prereqs T11+T12 done. After T13: T14 (fb display → exec eips -g), T15 (PGM stub), then T16 (Go ≤1.23 static build + size check), T17 (deploy + USER verification — the only display checks that count). After T17 proves the device path, revisit T18 (still blocked on T19 API key). After every state change: update this resume block + updated_at, commit together with the work.

todos.title: Jailbreak Kindle Voyage (WatchThis legacy + custom hotfix bin)
todos.details: WatchThis release tree + custom hotfix (SP01, SHA 2102e30f…) installed 21.09.2026. ROM stays read-only; exec from FAT not possible (drives T04). No 5.14+ update (breaks chain).
todos.verification: hotfix bin on card, .boot + refresh.sh run after reboot, capability est. 100% (MRPI logs)

todos.title: Network PoC: device reaches n8n webhook (wget)
todos.details: BusyBox wget from device to the n8n webhook over LAN; binary response readable on card.
todos.verification: wget PoC green, HTTP 200 + PNG bytes on card

todos.title: Static ARM Go binary dash (cross-compiled, CGO off)
todos.details: Static linux/arm binary, runs on kernel 3.0.35. Source on the user's machine (canonical repo-relative location: `src/kindle-dash/`), not in repo yet — see T11.
todos.verification: deployed + executed on device (SHA e2732446…, 6,291,616 B)

todos.title: Exec-from-FAT problem: stage to /tmp, re-stage on size change
todos.details: refresh.sh v4: size check → re-stage dash to /tmp (tmpfs) → run. Makes future dash replacements hot-swappable without reboot choreography.
todos.verification: refresh.sh v4 (2,720 B, SHA b1c06190…) live on card, cycles clean in refresh.log

todos.title: Identify eips -g as render path + prove the two hard requirements
todos.details: eips -b = NO-OP on KV. eips -g: (1) IHDR color type MUST be 0 (grayscale), (2) exactly 1 IDAT (first chunk read, rest dropped → zoomed crop). Supersedes the afternoon 'accepts 8-bit RGB' belief via controlled 32×32 experiment.
todos.verification: controlled 8×8/32×32 + 3,697 B full-frame tests pixel-exact; broken cases preserved (dashboard-real.png.bak, webhook captures)

todos.title: v1 unattended refresh loop (wget + eips, ~1 min cycle)
todos.details: First live loop; worked unattended. Superseded by v3/v4 (kept for history).
todos.verification: ran unattended on device (superseded, not a failure)

todos.title: n8n code node t180 (gold code, sandbox-verified byte-exact)
todos.details: t180-n8n.js (14,565 B, SHA 76f8f8b2…) implements transpose+180° in the code node; verified byte-exact vs golden in the n8n sandbox. NEVER deployed (API key 401 → T19). Orientation therefore still handled on device side.
todos.verification: 28,052,160-pixel comparison PASS in sandbox; deploy blocked (T19)

todos.title: Working-buffer analysis (fb0 dump, plane/stride, 16 px drift)
todos.details: fb0 = 2 planes (3,104,512 B = 1072×2896, 16-bit LE); pre-FLASH dump: 4 values {0x3de, 0x3c0, 0x1e, 0x0}; agreement ~0.86; ~16 px/row drift (1072 vs 1088 stride); shear simulation gives no improvement → NO shear in production path.
todos.verification: eips -k dump analysis (documented in docs/03); decision: go through eips, no offset hacks

todos.title: v3 Mac-proxy architecture + bistable dashboard.png visible
todos.details: Mac proxy served the image; eips -g rendered it each cycle. Kept the Mac in the loop permanently → superseded by final architecture (T12-T17). Currently visible image is the bistable remainder of this phase.
todos.verification: user-visible dashboard (superseded by design, not by failure)

todos.title: Final architecture decision: device-side grayscale + single-IDAT + eips
todos.details: dash = fetch + Go decode + Floyd-Steinberg + saveKindlePNG → /mnt/us/dashboard.png; display = exec eips -g (30 s), download 300 s. n8n stays RGB (converted on device).
todos.verification: decided 24.09 after T08 working-buffer analysis; plan fixed at I10 steps 1-7

todos.title: Obtain Go source into src/kindle-dash/ (repo-relative)
todos.verification: All 6 files present in src/kindle-dash/ and byte-match the Notion Artifacts canonical sizes (go.mod 20, main.go 2695, render.go 416, convert.go 2604, fb_linux.go 2322, fb_stub.go 511). go vet clean; compiles for darwin (local) + linux/arm GOARM=7 (device arch); the linux/arm build is 6,291,616 B = the EXACT size of the deployed reference binary. convert.go 1-byte loss at the Teil A/B join found + fixed (2603→2604, blank line before errA restored per Notion Teil B). A fresh build's SHA differs from the reference only because it was built with go1.27.1 and no -trimpath — T16 rebuilds with Go ≤1.23 + -trimpath. Gold-standard confirmation = byte-diff vs the user's Mac originals (Notion storage is lossy: trailing newlines stripped).
todos.details: Files: go.mod, main.go, render.go, convert.go, fb_linux.go, fb_stub.go (flat layout, no cmd/dash/), transcribed from the Notion Artifacts page (the canonical source; split code blocks rejoined). NOTE: files have NO trailing newline — faithful to the Notion code blocks, which strip the trailing \n; `gofmt -l` flags all 5 .go files for that single point only (mid-file content is gofmt-clean). Kept faithful (no `gofmt -w`) per the 'must not be invented' rule + documented sizes; gofmt-cleaning (add trailing newlines) is an optional user decision. 24.09: absolute user-specific paths removed from all repo references (user works across machines); canonical location is repo-relative src/kindle-dash/.

todos.title: Implement saveKindlePNG in convert.go (filter-0 rows → ONE zlib stream → 1 IDAT, color type 0)
todos.details: saveKindlePNG + writePNGChunk added to convert.go: manual PNG (SIG + IHDR bd=8 ct=0 compression/filter/interlace=0, one IDAT via compress/zlib over all filter-0 rows, CRC32 IEEE), NOT image/png (blocks at ~32 KB → 48 IDAT). Self-test in convert_test.go: (a) 64×32 gradient — chunk walk asserts exactly 1 IDAT, bitdepth 8, colortype 0, correct dims, and a pixel-exact round-trip via *image.Gray; (b) 1072×1448 sample dump for external validation.
todos.verification: go vet clean; go test PASS; darwin build compiles; linux/arm GOARM=7 build = 6,291,616 B = the EXACT deployed-reference size (saveKindlePNG is dead code until T13 wires it in → linker eliminates it, binary size unchanged). docs/03 shell validator on the 1072×1448 sample: size 1072×1448, bitdepth 8, colortype 0, 1 IDAT, raw scanline bytes 1,553,704 = 1448×(1072+1). Python reference golden (save_kindle_png on identical input): Go-decompressed raw scanlines are BYTE-IDENTICAL to the reference (full file differs only in the zlib stream, which eips never reads raw).

todos.title: main.go get(): remove all rotation/mirror code (image arrives pre-oriented from n8n)
todos.details: Keep: fetch, decode, grayscale, downscale, quantize. Drop: rotation/mirror handling of the input (DASH_FLIPX/DASH_FLIPY become obsolete). Output geometry 1072×1448.

todos.title: fb_linux.go display(): replace mmap with exec /usr/sbin/eips -g <file> -x 0 -y 0
todos.details: RISK: static binary may lack permission to exec eips (AppArmor/seccomp). Fallback if rc!=0 persists: dash stops at 'write PNG only' and refresh.sh itself calls eips afterwards. Log the exec result to diag.log either way.

todos.title: fb_stub.go: PGM output for development on the Mac
todos.details: Build tag for non-linux: render path writes a PGM the developer can inspect; removes dead env-var branches (DASH_FLIPX/Y).

todos.title: Static ARM build (Go ≤ 1.23) + size check
todos.details: CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm GOARM=7 go build -ldflags="-s". Go 1.24+ FORBIDDEN (needs Linux ≥3.2; device 3.0.35). Compare size to 6.29 MB; on success replace artifacts/binaries/dash + update SHA in docs/05.

todos.title: Deploy + user verification (visibility, orientation, flicker) + log check
todos.details: Deploy via hot re-stage (refresh.sh v4 size check) + reboot; validate_png on the produced file; user confirms: visible? orientation vs t180 reference? flicker acceptable? Then: refresh.log shows 'dl ok' + 'render rc=0'. On success: update README current-state table + docs (repo wins over Notion).
